    Supported representatives through the connecting map (Corollary 10.5, coefficient form) #

    cor:zero-supported-coverage (integral-deformations.tex) on the coefficient complexes of CharComplex, with 𝒪 = ℤ/4 and the sequence 0 → 𝔽₂ → 𝒪 → 𝔽₂ → 0: Lemma 10.4 (supported_bockstein) applies to C¹ → C² → C³ of character χ with U the pairs (u, v) with uv = 0 whose stem product is the ray w₂(u, v). Condition (2) is Theorem 9.1(3): a derivation modulo two has nonzero-product Leibniz coefficients (IsSol), which lift to ℤ by integral_lifting; the lifted coboundary vanishes on nonzero products and lands in the stem lines at zero products (d1_isSol_mem_U). Condition (1) is Proposition 10.3 (IStar). This gives the corollary over 𝔽₂ (cor105_coeff₂); "It may be chosen over 𝔽₂ and then extended to k": a class over k has a coordinate class over 𝔽₂ which is not a coboundary, and a retraction k → 𝔽₂ shows that its supported representative stays a non-coboundary over k (cor105_coeff).
